title: Ohio State fraternity suspended after viral video shows two men on fire
summary_full: The university and local police are conducting investigations into Sigma Alpha Epsilon and have placed them on interim suspensionA fraternity at Ohio State University has been temporarily suspended while authorities investigate a video that appears to show two panicked men engulfed in flames.A video shared on social media shows one individual with his sweatpants on fire who then lunges at a second individual and tackles him to the ground. The second man’s clothing also catches fire, and they both roll on the ground while removing their clothes as several onlookers intervene. Continue reading...
